//: End-of-security-support dates of the runtimes Atlas ships or builds with, read by tools/ci/check_eol.py (STORY-atlas-lcm-plan item 2). Source: endoflife.date's API, https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/<product>/ (field eolFrom), read on the `checked` date. Refresh with `python tools/ci/check_eol.py --online --update`; the weekly security run compares this table with the API and fails when they disagree, and the PR gate fails once `checked` is older than max_age_days.

2.note: no end of life announced for 2.x; fixes ship only in the newest 2.x release, which Dependabot (tag + digest) and the Trivy scan cover

9.note: Red Hat UBI 9, the base of the OpenShift images (ubi9/python-312-minimal, ubi9/go-toolset, ubi9/ubi-micro); end of maintenance support

1.26.note: ubi9/go-toolset:1.26 compiles the UBI Caddy (deploy/caddy/Dockerfile.ubi). A Go release is supported until two newer ones exist; endoflife.date sets the date then, and the weekly --online run reports it

cloudflared.note: deploy/prod.override.yml's tunnel connector (internet-facing). Dependabot does not read that file; this rule fails the gate once the pinned release month is more than 92 days old. Cloudflare supports a release for one year, but fixes only ship in new releases.
